name: Effective Range / Positive No-Clashing Teaching Dimension
details: Assign each concept all of its positive active coordinates.
proof: Assign h the positive examples on all active coordinates in h. For two distinct concepts, one has an active coordinate absent from the other; the positive sample of that concept is inconsistent with the other. Hence this assignment is non-clashing and has size at most \(\mathrm E(\mathcal H)\).
